settings.kvkk.title: Personal data protection
settings.kvkk.subtitle: Privacy notices, data-subject requests, retention and destruction, sub-processors, breach records and the VERBİS inventory (Turkish KVKK, Law 6698).
settings.kvkk.readOnly: Auditor view: you can inspect the records but not change them.
settings.kvkk.notices.hint: Texts are filled in from your company data, the inventory, the sub-processors and transfers abroad; a published version is frozen (publish a new one instead). Platform texts (terms, processing agreement) belong to the operator.
settings.kvkk.notices.generateHint: The draft is generated from the default template; review and edit it before publishing. Not legal advice.
settings.kvkk.notices.publishedToast: Published; the previous version was retired.
settings.kvkk.dsr.hint: Data-subject requests must be answered free of charge within 30 days (KVKK art. 13). Verify the identity before erasure or the "all my data" report.
settings.kvkk.dsr.subject: Linked record (customer)
settings.kvkk.dsr.created: Request recorded; the response period started.
settings.kvkk.dsr.eraseConfirm: This cannot be undone. Documents within the legal retention (invoices, despatch advices) are kept; then the erasure is partial and a reasoned answer is produced.
settings.kvkk.dsr.erasedPartial: Erasure applied partially (restricted by legal retention).
settings.kvkk.destruction.hint: Data past its retention is listed monthly; it is anonymised / deleted after an administrator approves. Periodic destruction runs at least every 6 months; destruction records are kept at least 3 years. Legal records (10 years) are only listed.
settings.kvkk.destruction.awaiting: Categories skipped because their recommended period is not yet approved: {list}
settings.kvkk.destruction.noCandidates: Nothing has reached the end of retention.
settings.kvkk.destruction.approveConfirm: {n} items will be anonymised / deleted. This cannot be undone and is written to the destruction records.
settings.kvkk.retention.hint: Default periods come with their sources. The company may lengthen a period but never go below the legal minimum. Recommended periods are not used for destruction until the company approves them.
settings.kvkk.processors.hint: Processors receiving personal data and their countries. A transfer abroad needs a KVKK art. 9 basis (adequacy, standard contract, BCR or incidental); a standard contract is notified to the Board within 5 business days.
settings.kvkk.processors.name: Name
settings.kvkk.incidents.hint: A breach is notified to the Board within 72 hours of becoming aware of it (KVKK art. 12/5). Alerts open suspected records; the clock starts when you confirm the breach.
settings.kvkk.incidents.affectedTotal: {n} people with records as of {date} may be affected.
settings.kvkk.verbis.required: The VERBİS registration thresholds are exceeded: {reasons}.
settings.kvkk.verbis.notRequired: Based on the figures entered, VERBİS registration does not appear mandatory (the thresholds may change by Board decision).
settings.kvkk.verbis.inputsMissing: Enter the number of employees and the balance-sheet total.
settings.kvkk.verbis.special: Main activity is processing special-category data
settings.kvkk.inventory.title: Personal data processing inventory (VERBİS structure)
settings.kvkk.chain.title: Audit trail integrity
settings.kvkk.chain.hint: Audit records are append-only and hash-chained. Verification recomputes the chain and every record's content.
settings.kvkk.chain.ok: Chain intact: {n} records verified ({masked} masked for KVKK).
settings.kvkk.closure.title: Close the company account
settings.kvkk.closure.hint: Take a full export first. Closing deletes data without a legal retention duty (integrations, sessions, non-admin accounts, customers without transactions); the rest stays read-only until the end of retention (31 Dec + 10 years).
settings.kvkk.closure.confirm: The company account will be closed and its data frozen read-only. This cannot be undone.
